moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season begins this weekend, with defending champions Arsenal hosting Coventry City on Friday, August 21st, and a full slate of fixtures including Hull City vs Manchester United on Saturday and Newcastle United vs Liverpool on Sunday.
